title: CdxFlag
description: A companion-diagnostic match: a variant or biomarker in this report that matches the FDA-approved (or other regulator) labeling indication for a specific drug in a specific tumor type. CDx flags are the highest-confidence therapy implications because they are directly anchored to a regulator-approved label, not derived from inference. Maps to the FHIR Genomics 'Therapeutic Implication' Observation profile.

cdxFlagId.description: Stable UUID for this CDx flag within this NGS interpretation response.

triggeredBy.description: List of variant or biomarker IDs from this same response that triggered the match. Each ID must resolve to a Variant.variantId or Biomarker.biomarkerId in the same NgsInterpretationResponse payload.

refType.description: Whether the trigger reference is a Variant or a Biomarker.

name.description: International nonproprietary name (INN) of the drug, lowercase (e.g., 'osimertinib', 'capmatinib', 'larotrectinib').

tumorType.description: Cancer type or histology in the FDA label indication (e.g., 'metastatic non-small cell lung cancer', 'BRCA-mutated metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer').

line.description: Line-of-therapy restriction in the approval, when present.

snomedCode.description: Optional SNOMED CT code for the tumor type.

approvalRegime.description: Which regulatory body issued the approval underlying this CDx flag. UNMIRI's primary regime is FDA; international regimes are reported when the source KB carries them.

approvalDate.description: Date the regulator approved this drug-biomarker-indication combination.

approvedAssay.description: The specific assay product that is the regulator-approved CDx for this indication, when applicable. Used to flag whether the source report's vendor-product is itself the approved CDx, or merely a comparable assay producing the same biomarker call.

externalLevels.description: Optional map of proprietary or third-party evidence levels keyed by knowledge-base identifier (e.g., {"civic": "A"}). Use only with appropriate licensing for the referenced knowledge base. The open-source schema does not prescribe values for any particular KB.

evidence.description: Evidence-tier metadata. AMP/ASCO/CAP 2017 is the public taxonomy carried in the open contract. For CDx flags, this is typically Tier I-A (FDA-recognized biomarker). Proprietary or third-party levels go in externalLevels keyed by knowledge-base name.

citations.description: Authoritative sources for this CDx claim: FDA label PDF, peer-reviewed primary trial publication, and any KB record under appropriate licensing terms.
